Name: SSH Weak MAC Algorithms Enabled
Synopsis: The remote SSH server is configured to allow weak MAC algorithms.
Description: The remote SSH server supports one or more weak message authentication code algorithms. These are considered legacy and should be disabled as a best practice.
Solution: Disable weak MAC algorithms in SSH server configuration. Restrict to hmac-sha2-256 and hmac-sha2-512.

Name: SSL Certificate Expiring Within 60 Days
Synopsis: The SSL certificate on this host is expiring within 60 days.
Description: The SSL/TLS certificate installed on the remote service is set to expire within the next 60 days. Plan for timely renewal to avoid disruption.
Solution: Renew the SSL certificate before expiration.
